latest_mutant.description: CANopen CiA 301 NMT & SAE J1939 control flow bug: OP_JZ branches when z is deasserted (if (!z)) instead of when z is asserted (if (z)), causing equality matches (Node-ID matching, NMT CS decoding 0x01/0x02/0x80, and J1939 PDU2 broadcast detection) to fail to branch and drop into mismatched bypass paths
